notes.title: August Update - A First "Look" at our Audio
notes.content:
[p]It’s update time! This month we are happy to give you a first “look” into our audio![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Meet the cast[/b][/h3][p]But first some art updates 🎨 We have been working intensively on the characters this month and have created assets for the full cast of characters that you will meet in the village! Let’s hope nothing bad happens to them :)[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/2b09924eec2ca08c7ce164d2b0271bea061bd298.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Refactoring[/b][/h3][p]Although it’s summer, spring cleaning has started and we are deleting legacy assets and code left and right. It’s finally time to get rid of all the messy prototyping code that lived in the project for far too long and make space for their successors. While there isn’t much that we can show on this yet we do have a little teaser for new things in the works:[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/777d01ea8d815867a02f412dab63713f9874472a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Audio[/b][/h3][p]As promised we have the first [i]very early [/i]drafts of some music our audio wizards cooked up! This particular track is meant for the village, so it’s supposed to be serene, welcoming and make you momentarily forget about the dangers that lurk within the forest 🎶[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/jCM0ll1QMG4"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]That's it for this month! As always, we would love to hear your thoughts - feel free to join our [url="https://discord.gg/qtvwdZjcvy"]Discord[/url] and let us know what you think! [/p]

notes.title: July Update - Big UI Changes
notes.content: [p]A new month, a new update! This is a shorter one as we mainly worked on implementing past months concepts but we still got some new things to show you - let’s get into it![/p][p][/p][h2][b]Environment[/b][/h2][p]Starting off with the new forest environment that you saw in our last update! We’ve already added a quick parallax to get a feel for the space, and really love how it’s looking so far. The fog between layers will likely get more polish later on, but for now, it offers a nice eerie atmosphere to the forest already. We also added some bushes around the ground - they weren’t in the original concept, but it felt a bit too desolate without them.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/006fb4b2ce83a99a0385143f80e5cd602337e325.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]UI[/b][/h2][p]Big changes in the UI once again this month - we swapped out the pixel font for something more legible! For our narrative-heavy game, the pixel font just didn’t cut it. We chose something more accessible that still fits nicely  with the style of the UI.[/p][p]We also updated the looks of our dialogue UI which you can see in the image below! The vertical layout solves a lot of our space issues and allows us to easily display previous dialogue.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/db0236efe54e9d6b5b06ed6593756d70ef150a68.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]All new Ida[/b][/h2][p]Our local scientist Ida was the first to receive a full character makeover. Because we changed the UI’s pixel density, we now have a lot of free real estate for the portraits - Ida’s no-nonsense attitude is almost palpable now.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/bbbe15f3542b1c9895874b43cdecf726c4d4366c.png"][/img][/p][p]And that’s already it for this month's update ✨ As always let us know what you think - any feedback is welcome![/p]

notes.title: June Update - New Concept Art!
notes.content: [p]Heya everyone and welcome to our very first Steam update! [/p][p][/p][p]We’ve been overhauling the game's UI, characters and environment design and are happy to show you the results![/p][p]Please remember that these are only concepts and nothing is set in stone yet. And as always, we’d love to hear your thoughts! [/p][p][/p][h2]UI [/h2][p]Our old UI design was inspired by the Art Deco of the era - but that kind of glamour wouldn't have reached the remote villages like the one in Eldritch Empathy. We wanted the UI to better reflect the remote village environment, so it fits the setting. We took inspiration from Swiss country style; think hand-painted flower ornaments on wooden boards! The new UI design now feels consistent and coherent. And fits the world a lot better - take a look: [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/0463625694ea56ab742408f2cdfd7bd066278eff.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Environment [/h2][p]We are currently experimenting with some style directions for the village and forest locations. We’ve felt the rounded trees from our previous concept just didn’t feel spooky enough for the vibes of the outside. The newest concept features coniferous trees, which, as we all know, are creepy (for some reason). We are happy to hear your thoughts on this one because there’s a lot of different opinions floating around! Any favorites?[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/1ba42dee9f9a6a776438b957c3b0fada0f8b760c.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Eldritch Entity [/h2][p]When the protagonist inevitably succumbs to the eldritch influences outside, they’ll have a little heart-to-heart with the source of all the suffering: the big eldritch entity itself.[/p][p]We wanted the entity to feel alien whilst giving them some recognizable features so that it’s easier to emotionally connect with them. Since eyes are the window to the soul - and terrifying at the same time - it felt fitting to go with some semblance of an “eye” for the entity. [/p][p]You might even recognize the “eye” motif from the environment concepts above 👀[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45156871/c1a3c4bcf7223b3be0b1d8917987b248060e0e5b.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Miscellaneous [/h2][p]We are also diving deeper into the story - we have some interesting ideas for the second act in which the village finds itself in the center of a smaller, much more intimate conspiracy 🐙[/p][p]On the design side, we are currently reworking core systems with combat being our focus for the moment. Right now it’s all just crazy ramblings but once we can share some more coherent ideas, we will do so in this space.[/p]
